name: frotzsave
description: frotz(6) Quetzal save/restore ROUND-TRIPS THROUGH THE FILESYSTEM: two game sessions in one boot.  Session 1 begins Book and Volume, drops the key, saves to an explicit file (bv.sav in the shell's cwd) and quits; session 2 relaunches frotz, restores the same file from the title menu (R) and asks for the inventory.  THE DISCRIMINATOR is the key: a restored game carries only the pager, a fresh one 'your pager and your key', so a save that wrote nothing or a restore that read nothing leaves the key in the inventory and the test red.
